# `is_valid_variant`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
is_valid_variant(v)
```

Returns true if the variant is valid, false if it is malformed, NULL if `v` is NULL.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT is_valid_variant(parse_json('null'));
```

Result:

```text
true
```

```sql
SELECT is_valid_variant(parse_json('[{"b":true,"a":0}]'));
```

Result:

```text
true
```
